name: kalem-gumruk-monorepo
description: Kalem Gümrük Müşavirliği - Bağımsız Frontend & Backend Mimarisi

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run start --prefix frontend"
